quotes.author: Mike Johnston
quotes.text: Tim Stout is pure class, even when the fishing gods aren't smiling. Got completely blanked today but Tim's personality made it worthwhile.

quotes.author: Michael Sennett
quotes.text: Great day on the water with Captain Tim. Caught plenty of fish and Tim works to keep you on them. Would highly recommend

quotes.author: Ryan Milavickas
quotes.text: It was a tough day for the bite but Captain Tim didn’t give up. Limited out on Reds!!!
Captain Tim did a great job with our group, including our three- and four-year-old children. He was patient, enthusiastic, and worked hard to find the fish by taking us to several different spots.
Captain Tim is an excellent guide. My three kids and myself fished with him. He was extremely patient and polite with my kids. He provided plenty of bait and several quality fishing rods.

Another great trip with the Great Captain Tim! Took two rookie grandsons with me this time and they caught monster Snook! Along with Reds and Trout. Plenty of bait, great gear, and super comfortable boat. Already booked for next week to show him off to more relatives!

Capt. Tim is the consummate captain, guide, story teller and fisherman! My wife and I had a great time on his boat and he took us to some honey holes that produced a lot of fish of varied species. We will be booking with him again for sure!
